methodologyNotes: Roster of 13 in-wall smart light switches and dimmers spanning Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Clear Connect, and Matter, verified against manufacturer product pages (Lutron Caseta/Aurora, Kasa, Leviton, TP-Link Tapo, Meross, GE Cync, Wyze, Inovelli, Enbrighten/Jasco) and corroborated by retail listings and CSA-IOT. Prices reflect the lowest verified published USD price from an authorised channel, or MSRP where a canonical figure exists; where no single-pack USD price could be confirmed the field is null rather than guessed. Boolean spec fields are stated capability per the manufacturer; works_with lists assistant/hub ecosystems confirmed on official pages. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Adversarial pass: corrected the Meross price note (sale $29.99 vs list $37.99), nulled the unconfirmable Tapo S505D single-pack price, and re-verified every model's existence (all 13 are real; none removed).

products.name: Lutron Caseta Diva Smart Dimmer Switch (DVRF-6L)
products.priceNote: Verified street/MSRP at ProLighting and Bees Lighting, white variant
products.provenance: Caseta page confirms no neutral, hub required, 3-way via Pico remote, Clear Connect RF, 150W LED. Price $69.95 verified across ProLighting (white/black/almond all $69.95) and Bees Lighting. Ecosystems (Alexa, Apple Home, Google Home, Ring, Sonos) confirmed via Amazon DVRF-6L listing.

products.name: Lutron Caseta Original Smart Dimmer Switch (PD-6WCL)
products.priceNote: Street price at ProLighting and Best Buy; Lutron official list $72.00 (Caseta US price list PDF)
products.provenance: No neutral, hub required, 3-way via Pico, Clear Connect RF, 150W LED / 600W incandescent. Lutron official US price list quotes $72.00 MSRP; street $64.95 confirmed at ProLighting and Best Buy (PD-6WCL-WH-R). Alexa/Apple Home/Google/Ring confirmed via Amazon.

products.name: Lutron Aurora Smart Bulb Dimmer (Z3-1BRL)
products.priceNote: MSRP per ProLighting and Philips Hue store
products.provenance: Battery-powered (CR2032), clips over existing toggle — no wiring, no neutral, not 3-way. Zigbee 3.0 confirmed; controls up to 12 Zigbee bulbs directly, up to 50 via Hue Bridge. Price $39.95 confirmed via ProLighting and Hue store.

products.provenance: Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz, no hub, neutral required, single pole, Alexa + Google only (NO HomeKit — HomeKit is the separate KS200). Price ~$14.99 corroborated; Slickdeals showed $10.99 in 2026.

products.name: Enbrighten Z-Wave 800 Series In-Wall Smart Switch (76591)

specs.works_with: alexa, google_home, smartthings, ring, wink, homeseer

products.provenance: Enbrighten site (re-fetched) confirms $39.99, Z-Wave Plus Long Range 800 (1,300ft), hub required, direct 3-way (one dumb 3-way switch, or up to four add-ons), Alexa/Google via Z-Wave hub.
